stem:
Arnav divides 9.6 by 4.

Which claim keeps the quotient decimal point in the correct place?

options.text: The important label is counting-number divisor, so the quotient is 4.
Divide 96 by 4 to get 24 and leave the decimal point out of the quotient.
Place the decimal point in the quotient above the decimal point in 9.6, then divide to get 2.4.
The quotient is 9.6, because that is the printed decimal in the stem.

teacher.key_rationale: 9.6 ÷ 4 = 2.4 when the quotient point sits above the dividend point before dividing tenths. Naming the divisor is not the quotient. Dropping the point turns 2.4 into 24. Copying 9.6 ignores the division.
